page.heading: Roles & permissions
page.description: Built-in roles cover most cases. Add a custom role when you need a narrower or different slice of access — pick exactly the permissions it should have, then assign it to any user.

form.description: Pick exactly the permissions this role should grant. A system role's permissions are fixed — clone them into a new role to start from one.
form.readOnlyDescription: A system role's permissions are fixed. Clone them into a new role to start from this set.

usersDialog.title: Users with the "{{name}}" role
usersDialog.description: Check a user to grant this role, uncheck to revoke it. Takes effect on their next request.

toasts.error: Could not update this user's role

delete.title: Delete this role?
delete.body: Removed from every user who has it. This cannot be undone.
